text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down roughly 2% over 24 hours, suggesting mild profit-taking after a period of strength. Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 59% alongside a $92B daily volume indicates conviction in the flagship assets rather than panic rotation. The Fear & Greed index sitting at 73 (Greed) and climbing shows investors remain confident despite the slight pullback, pointing to a consolidation phase rather than a reversal of trend.
